items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was doing the “Soupy Sales Show” in Detroit.

ctx.x: There’s some other good stories that I remember, compliments that I just wanted to mention that I’m proud of like when I think of it. There’s one, I was doing the “Soupy Sales Show” in Detroit. And I was walking down the street and I run into Bill Evans. And he says “I saw you on the ‘Soupy Sales Show’ I really dig your lines.” Which was great.
Isn’t that interesting that he would pick that out, from Soupy Sales.
